Resolves #19863

The lock moves `@playwright/test`, `playwright` and `playwright-core` to 1.64.1, the same tarballs Dependabot resolved on #19859. `PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLED_FEATURES` gains `AvoidCorsURLLoaderRestartOnRedirect` at the position upstream gives it. Our single `--disable-features` again repeats Playwright's full list, so the E2E browser keeps Playwright's fix for Chromium 155's aborted cross-origin redirects. Once this merges, Dependabot rebases #19859 down to its other four updates.

Evidence: L1 (the #19675 unit arm against the installed 1.64.1, plus the full unit suite) → L1 required for AC-1–3 (the lock content and the arm are unit-observable; E2E runs in CI). Residual: AC-4 needs #19859's rebase after this merges.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | Outside-CI: `git diff package-lock.json` moves only the three packages; each `integrity` equals #19859's |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/e2e/glState.spec.mjs`, "#19675 every launch profile keeps Playwright's disabled features in its one --disable-features" |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: the unit and E2E jobs at head |
| AC-4 | Post-merge: #19859's rebase, see below |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive.

## Test Evidence
- Red first: with 1.64.1 installed and `dev`'s copy, the #19675 arm fails locally on `- "AvoidCorsURLLoaderRestartOnRedirect"`, the same failure as #19859's run. With the entry added, the spec passes 11/11 and `npm run test-unit` passes 5285 tests.
- Lockfile: only the three packages' `version` / `resolved` / `integrity` lines move.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] #19859 rebases to js-yaml, mermaid, sass and webpack, goes green and auto-merges (AC-4)
